endo_report:
This is a gastroscopy report.
Esophagus: Mucosa is smooth and soft, with clear vascular pattern, good distensibility, and a distinct dentate line.
Cardia: No abnormalities observed.
Fundus: No abnormalities observed.
Body: Mucosa is smooth and reddish in color; no ulcers or bleeding noted.
Angulus: Mucosa shows mixed red and white areas.
Antrum: Mucosa shows mixed red and white areas; mucosa in the prepyloric region is hyperemic.
Pylorus: Round in shape, opens and closes adequately; mucosal folds are smooth and pale red, with no ulceration or bleeding.
Duodenum: No abnormalities observed in the bulb or descending portion.
